mkdir -p /tmp/sections
for f in /task/screenshots/*.png; do
  name=$(basename $f .png)
  # Get height
  h=$(file $f | grep -oE '[0-9]+ x [0-9]+' | awk -F' x ' '{print $2}')
  echo "$name: height=$h"
  # Split into 1500-pixel sections at ~600 width
  ffmpeg -y -i $f -vf "crop=iw:1500:0:0,scale=600:-1" /tmp/sections/${name}_1.png 2>&1 | tail -1 > /dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -i $f -vf "crop=iw:1500:0:1500,scale=600:-1" /tmp/sections/${name}_2.png 2>&1 | tail -1 > /dev/null
  ffmpeg -y -i $f -vf "crop=iw:1500:0:3000,scale=600:-1" /tmp/sections/${name}_3.png 2>&1 | tail -1 > /dev/null
  if [ "$h" -gt 4500 ]; then
    ffmpeg -y -i $f -vf "crop=iw:min(1500\,ih-4500):0:4500,scale=600:-1" /tmp/sections/${name}_4.png 2>&1 | tail -1 > /dev/null
  fi
done
